replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
- Badge on all platforms
- TS Meeting Room & Lounge
- Access to Avicus GitHub
- Creative mode, WorldEdit, map commands
- Access to 3 development servers
- Access to private build server
- Slack access /w the other staff

Hope I answered your question.
